_why: What the table-footing gate found in the studies that do NOT yet carry a footing_check.py, recorded on 03-Sep-2026 so the finding is not lost between sessions. A case whose closest printed block lands within a few per cent of the stated total is the TMGH SIGNATURE — a summary statement omitting small lines it holds as registered inputs, which closes at the top and fails a reader in every block below. Those are REAL. The rest are probably structural (a disclosed line item among its peers, a transposed cost-of-capital table, a blend across a dimension the column does not carry) and need a declaration with a reason, not a fix. NEITHER IS RESOLVED HERE: these studies stay on the ratchet until somebody looks at each case, which is what the ratchet is for.

_resolved_since.ADNOCDRILL: FIXED 03-Sep-2026. The forecast liability block was ~USD 32mn short in every forecast year because ACQUISITION LIABILITIES sit inside the model's forecast total_liabilities and were printed nowhere; the audited years footed because their total is struck as assets less equity rather than as an explicit sum. The line is printed, both halves foot, and the study now carries a footing_check with two narrow structural declarations.
_resolved_since.TMGH: FIXED 03-Sep-2026. Intangibles, right-of-use and deferred tax (748.0 exactly) and work in progress (23.6) were registered inputs the balance sheet did not print.
_resolved_since.EMPOWER: FIXED 03-Sep-2026. ELEVEN asset and liability lines sat in the filings and in the study's own extraction and were mapped into no printed row: right-of-use, deferred tax, other financial assets and due-from-related-parties on the asset side (94,729 thousand on FY2023) and retentions, the deferred government grant, end-of-service benefits and due-to-related-parties on the liability side (517,383 thousand). Both residuals are now printed as named rows, and the builder ASSERTS that each residual IS the sum of the specific lines it names — a residual row that is merely a plug foots by construction and proves nothing.

_unresolved.AMR: REAL AND NOT FIXABLE FROM HERE. The printed asset lines sum to USD 10.4mn short of the disclosed total in FY2023 and similarly in FY2024-25. Unlike TMGH and ADNOCDRILL, THE STUDY DOES NOT HOLD THE MISSING LINE: no registered input matches the residual, so it is an asset line the study never captured. SIGCM clause 1 forbids inventing it and this desk does not hold AMR's filings. Stays on the ratchet; clears when that study is next re-issued with its statements to hand.
_unresolved.RIYADHCABLE: Total assets short by 2.5-5.9% across three periods — the largest residual found. Not yet traced to a held input.
_unresolved.EIPICO (PHAR): Total enterprise value short by 0.4%. Smallest of the five and the only one not on a balance sheet.
